image_description: A vintage-style illustration or photograph of a Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) viewed from a dorsal-top-down perspective. The crab features a broad, oval-shaped carapace with a reddish-pink to purplish-brown hue and lighter mottling. It has five pairs of legs extending laterally, with the first pair modified into large, robust claws (chelipeds) that appear to have dark tips. The background is a plain, light beige surface with some faint, illegible text in the upper right corner.
